subsetPolicyRationale: `s.energy.model@1` is this plugin's own self-contained energy model document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (replace-model, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
